entities.summary: Dmitriy Viktorovich Dudarev is a Kazakhstani former professional ice hockey winger who notably played for Metallurg Novokuznetsk of the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He participated at the 2010 IIHF World Championship as a member of the Kazakhstan men's national ice hockey team.
